results.quote: Meta was subject to a record €1.2 billion ($1.3 billion) fine for breaching the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation

results.evidence_quote: May 12, 2023, the IDPC issued a Final Decision concluding that Meta Platforms Ireland's reliance on Standard Contractual Clauses in respect of certain transfers of European Economic Area (EEA) Facebook user data was not in compliance with the GDPR. The IDPC issued an administrative fine of EUR €1.2 billion as well as corrective orders, which is described further in "Legal Proceedings" contained in Part I, Item 3 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
results.explanation_ko: 2023년 5월 12일, IDPC는 메타 플랫폼 아일랜드가 GDPR을 준수하지 않았다고 결론짓고 12억 유로의 벌금을 부과했습니다. 이는 2026년 10-K 보고서에 명시되어 있습니다.
